notes.title: New Game! 'Never Give Up' is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300139/a0d11b69d9745d7b0ce60928c9fefa0ee3f8def3.png[/img]

Hey Pals!

[h1]Our new game [b]Never Give Up[/b] is out now![/h1] - and with a 10% launch discount!

Check out the trailer if it looks interesting to you :) 

https://youtu.be/17oUAlMSlEQ
> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/609420/Never_Give_Up/]Buy on Steam [/url]
> [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/never-give-up-switch/]Buy on Nintendo Switch [/url]

Never Give Up is a death-defying platformer packed full of vicious traps and hazards specifically designed to turn you into bloody chunks, and where the only way out— is through. It may break your keyboard, don't let it break your will.

[b]FEATURES[/b]
 [list]
[*] PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT: Iterative level design lets players build their mastery while generating new challenges at every turn.
[*]  EVERYBODY'S A CRITIC: We warned you that this game is hard, and every time you fail we're going to make fun of you until you GIVE UP. It builds character.
[*]  EVEN DEATH IS PROGRESS: Unique GIVE UP button lets you take the coward's way out without stopping your in-game advancement.
[*]  SPEEDRUNNERS, REJOICE: Built-in splits timer for speedrunners let you track every piece of route optimization on every iteration.
[*]  COSTUMES AND COLLECTIBLES: Do you like seeing clowns, robots, alligators and mimes dismembered by buzzsaws? Us too. Unlock all 20 costumes by finding collectibles and secrets in each level!
[*]  WAIT, THAT SOUNDS LIKE: One of the Game Grumps! Egoraptor! Yes, Arin Hanson voices the dashingly handsome and occasionally dismembered BLUE!
[/list]

That's all for now! More massive monster news coming soon :)

notes.title: RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT: Never Give Up out 13th August
notes.content:
Hey pals!

We have a [b]NEW GAME[/b] releasing next Tuesday, 13th August!

If you enjoyed [i]The Adventure Pals[/i] but didnt find it challenging enough, this is the game for you! We were working on both games at the same time for a number of years and cannot wait to finally share it with you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300139/a0d11b69d9745d7b0ce60928c9fefa0ee3f8def3.png[/img]

Never Give Up is a death-defying platformer packed full of vicious traps and hazards specifically designed to turn you into bloody chunks, and where the only way out— is through. It may break your keyboard, don't let it break your will.

Based on the classic Flash game series [i]Give Up[/i], and voiced by GameGrump Arin 'Egoraptor' Hanson, [i]Never Give Up[/i] is guaranteed to scratch that precision platforming itch.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/609420/Never_Give_Up/]Check out the Steam page and Wishlist now! [/url][/b]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: About four to six great new Steam games
notes.content:
It’s been a strange week here at the Pleasuredome. Once again, a bud of the Hivemind prepares to detach and spread in-jokes and sinister, fungaloid thoughts about user interfaces to a new, unsuspecting host. And I’d only just confirmed he’s real, too. Bye bye, Adam. Subvert from within, yeah?

Still, on the plus side, I high fived Aby Wolf the other night. And now it’s time for Unknown Pleasures! Heavens.

Shamelessly namedropping far more talented people we’ve briefly orbited this week: chasing rabbits, redirecting lasers, and justifying patricide.

(more…)

notes.title: Now Available: The Adventure Pals!
notes.content:
Saddle up that giraffe, because it's time to ride with The Adventure Pals! After years of hard work, we're thrilled to say the game is finally available to play, and we hope you all enjoy it!

Thank you to everyone who has supported us in every way possible while we've been banging away at this, and to everyone who is checking out the game today and in the future. We hope you have fun on your adventures with Sparkles and Mr. Rock, and thank you for giving us this chance to send you out on this wonderful, weird journey.

love and hotdogs,
The Adventure Pals Team

notes.title: Release Date: April 3rd!
notes.content:
They say time flies when you're having fun, and it seems like just yesterday we were announcing the official Kickstarter for The Adventure Pals when it was actually almost two years ago! But today we come bearing great news for all fans of hotdog-based evil plans, helicopter-tongued giraffes, and toast/dinosaur-centric conflicts... [b]The Adventure Pals will be released for everyone on April 3rd, 2018![/b]

Holy hotdogs, that's just one week from now! Thank you to everyone who has supported us and sent us encouragement, and for your patience as we tweaked, tuned, and hammered everything behind the scenes. We can't wait for you to get to play it!

notes.title: Phoenix Point will be playable at EGX Rezzed
notes.content: Our corporate siblings who run EGX Rezzed go on about how it’s a games show with all sorts of video games to play and talks to hear, but in reality it’s a front. Rezzed exists because we believe you will pay money to breathe the same air as RPS staffers, getting some of our air inside you and some of yours in us, but both sides are too embarrassed to publicly acknowledge that. So sure, okay, let’s keep up the facade. For example: Rezzed today announced more of the games playable in London this April, including X-COM co-creator Jullian Gollop’s fine-looking grid ’em up Phoenix Point. (more…)
